body:
The stored-value pilot's supplemental browser check returned an empty transcript and did not qualify the exact repeated-read/error task. This is a verification gap, not an established product defect. Native evidence and the later greeting/edit/export first-session check cover different boundaries.

On the current Meet BASIC remember-and-save page, execute the named-value task in the maintained embedded machine: demonstrate repeated reads before and after replacement (ONE, ONE, TWO), then the documented wrong-name/type error and repair. Confirm actual machine output and successful recovery, plus reset/revert behaviour. First reproduce the old harness failure and explain whether its observation method or product behaviour caused it. Do not accept missing output as success.

Acceptance: retain page/source/deployment/tool identities, browser and viewport, actual screen/transcript evidence, expected-versus-observed results and any failed attempts. Add only necessary verification repairs; file a product fix only if reproduced. Native success cannot substitute for embedded execution. Learner understanding remains unobserved. Parents: https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/115 and https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/124 . Evidence: Code198x/docs `audit/2026-10-spectrum-learner-journey/stored-value-pilot/REPORT.md` and its supplemental-browser-failure.json.
title: Qualify the embedded BASIC stored-value and error-recovery task
